column1: Table S8A. Direct methylation comparison between ONSEN terminal candidate regions and annotation-defined non-ONSEN LTR-retrotransposon terminal regions (principal element/copy-level analysis).

Principal inference: ONSEN terminal candidate regions show selectively elevated basal CHH methylation relative to the direct non-ONSEN LTR-retrotransposon comparator; CG and CHG are not detectably different. CG/CHG coverage is sparse for ONSEN (6 of 8 copies with usable data).
